svg.title: RoomOS icon crop calibration target
svg.desc: Nested square color bands extend to every canvas edge for measuring RoomOS icon scaling and clipping from a screenshot.
svg.metadata: Canvas: 512x512, fully opaque, zero padding. Bands measured inward from every edge: 0-15 px #FFFFFF white 16-31 px #111111 black 32-63 px #FF1744 red 64-95 px #FF9100 orange 96-127 px #FFD600 yellow 128-159 px #00E676 green 160-191 px #00E5FF cyan 192-223 px #2979FF blue 224-287 px #D500F9 magenta center
